newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shenzhen Textile 96 net 16 mln yuan.
newsitem.headline: Shenzhen Textile 96 net 16 mln yuan.

text.p: Shenzhen Textile (Holdings) Co Ltd reaped net profits of 15.82 million yuan in 1996, the Shenzhen Stock Exchange said in a notice after the market closed on Friday.
Earnings per share were 0.116 yuan in 1996 and turnover reached 195.09 million yuan, the exchange said.
It did not specify whether the results were compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards and gave no comparative figures.
In 1995, the company posted net profits of 20.19 million yuan on turnover of 274.7 million yuan, based on Chinese accounting standards.
Based on international accounting standards, its 1995 net profits were 10.23 million yuan.
The firm's board of directors proposed a two-for-10 bonus issue based on capital surplus, the exchange said.
Trading in the company's A and B shares will be suspended on Monday morning and will resume that afternoon, it said.
